posts.text:
Thanks to Congressional Republicans, ICE and Border Patrol are fully funded for the next three years. Proud to support their mission to keep Americans and our interior safe and secure.

Our brave law enforcement officers should never be diminished or politicized, and it’s a shame that not a single Democrat voted for this critical funding. I’m grateful for House passage and to see this reconciliation bill head to @POTUS’s desk - not a moment too soon.
